summary: Max Verstappen won the Mexico City Grand Prix from P3 on the grid, 13.9s ahead of Lewis Hamilton, with Charles Leclerc completing the podium.
Lando Norris made the biggest climb, from P17 to P5.
Valtteri Bottas had a day to forget, dropping from P9 to P15.
The race was neutralised by 1 red flag, 1 safety car and 1 virtual safety car.
There were 38 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 3 times.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 251 points over Sergio Perez.
